Container.Name: fclones-scheduler
Container.Overview:
Find and deduplicate files on a schedule, reclaiming wasted disk space automatically.
Runs the fclones duplicate finder against a share on an interval and reports duplicates found and space reclaimable in the container log. The default action only reports. Switch the action to link (replace duplicates with hardlinks), remove (delete duplicates) or dedupe (reflink) once a report has shown you what it would touch. No web UI, no open port.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: fclones duplicate files dedupe dedup hardlink reflink disk space
Container.Requires: Start with the default action (group): it only reports. link, remove and dedupe modify the files under the scan path, and remove deletes them. Hardlinks cannot span disks. For the link action, scan a single disk path such as /mnt/disk1/Media rather than /mnt/user/Media, or duplicates that live on two disks fail the run. The container reports unhealthy until its first scan completes; on a large share that can take hours. Later scans reuse the hash cache in /cache and are much faster.

Config.Name: Scan path
Config.Description: The share or folder to scan for duplicates, e.g. /mnt/user/Media (read-write is needed for link, remove and dedupe)

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: fclones hash cache and the last-scan record; keeps rescans fast and the schedule stable across restarts

Config.Name: Action
Config.Description: What to do with duplicates: group (report only), link (hardlink), remove (delete), dedupe (reflink). Anything but group modifies your files

Config.Name: Scan interval
Config.Description: Time between scans as a Go duration (3h, 12h, 24h). off = no schedule, trigger scans by hand; 0 = run one scan and exit

Config.Name: Scan paths
Config.Description: Container paths to scan, space-separated; each needs its own path mapping. Leave at /scandir unless you add more mappings

Config.Name: Scan arguments
Config.Description: Extra flags for the fclones group (scan) phase, e.g. --name '*.mkv' --name '*.mp4' or --rf-over 1; flags and their values only

Config.Name: Action arguments
Config.Description: Extra flags for the action phase, e.g. --priority bottom; --dry-run previews the action without changing files

Config.Name: Scan timeout
Config.Description: Per-phase timeout as a Go duration; raise it when a first scan of a large share exceeds 12h, 0 disables it

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error

Config.Name: Allow unsafe arguments
Config.Description: Set to true to allow the --transform, --in-place and --no-copy fclones flags, which are refused by default
